name: American Express Corporate Platinum Card

base_rate.description: Rewards depend on the company's corporate Membership Rewards enrollment; no earn rate is stated on the product page.

benefits.title: Airline fee credit
benefits.description: Up to $200 in statement credits per calendar year for incidental fees with one selected qualifying airline.

benefits.title: CLEAR+ credit
benefits.description: Up to $219 per calendar year in statement credits for an auto-renewing CLEAR+ membership.

benefits.title: Uber Cash on business rides
benefits.description: 5% Uber Cash on business Uber rides and Uber Eats orders charged to the card, with enrollment.

notes: Corporate card issued through a company program for employees. APR and foreign transaction fee are not stated on the product page.
